acceptance_policy.override_semantics: Every value in this file may be replaced with an application requirement by editing this file only; no code change is needed.  Values labelled recorded_baseline are the currently measured bars, values labelled project_decision are engineering thresholds.  The schema and all required keys must stay present and valid: a malformed file fails closed instead of silently reverting to the built-in fallback, which is used only when the file is absent.

energy_definition.rule: switching energy integrates the signed device current I(Lload)-I(Dclamp); timing, slew and i_peak stay on its absolute magnitude. A recorded bar without an energy_current_definition is legacy abs and its energy rows are reported as definition_mismatch, never scored as signed

static_bars_pct.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md sections 1.4 and 6; README measured table

static_score_estimator.rationale: G1 gates the arithmetic mean of per-curve peak-normalised rel RMSE; median and span values stay in the record as diagnostics

dpt_bars_pct.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 1.4; reports/comparison/<vendor>/tier3_validation_simplis.json#dpt_run.waveform (vds_rel_rmse_pct, id_rel_rmse_pct) on the algorithm.channel_candidate_selected=tier2 control row; pairs keyed by method label (trap/default, gear-both), EPC 100 ns cap on both arms

irfs7730pbf.source: docs/plans/phase_vi_research_framework.md section 3.3 (user-accepted relaxation); canonical C0 IRFS measured (9.999276, 0.575138) percent Vds/Id

relaxed_trap_default.scope: trap/default only; TI/EPC and all gear-both bars unchanged

timing_energy_bars.source: reports/comparison/<vendor>/tier3_validation.json#dpt_comparison.<metric>.golden (device-current golden DPT); independent of this pipeline's own recorded Tier-2 table
timing_energy_bars.energy_current_definition: the recorded tier3_validation.json rows carry no energy_current_definition and are legacy abs; a signed measured energy is reported as definition_mismatch instead of being scored against them
timing_energy_bars.tier2_regression_role: diagnostic only: reported as G4_tier2_regression and never scored in G4_timing_energy or in the verdict

speed_n_pulses.rationale: 20 pulses is the pinned adaptive row; a 2-pulse default row must never be compared to it

speed_repeats.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 1.3 item 7 (at least 3 interleaved repeats)

dpt_trace_point_fraction.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 1.3 item 5 (at least 50 percent of golden points)

tuning_max_evals.rationale: bounded derivative-free search over four named fields; not an emitter default

tuning_bounds.rationale: O_GD is capped at one full Q_RSS at the top of the measured curve-4 sweep; Qoss is frozen and never used for this gate-side bound

timing_band.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 6 G4 (no worse than the recorded golden DPT); reports/comparison/<vendor>/tier3_validation.json#dpt_comparison.<metric>.golden; absolute floor TIMING_BAND_ABS
timing_band.rationale: band = max(5 percent of |bar|, 1e-12) around each independent golden timing/energy bar: a much smaller delay is not an improvement when the device never turns on; a near-zero bar is not auto-passed; missing bars stay not_measured

zero_current_anchor.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 2.3 (VDS=0 and Vth cutoff guards); models/netlist_builder.py:_channel_expression
zero_current_anchor.rationale: 1 percent of the swept peak current is a structural G2 anchor tolerance, not a measured device current

tuning_golden_emp.rationale: golden metrics are cached once; completion uses recorded iterations, trace points and t_last. Non-completing conditions are never scored

tuning_candidate_libs.source: pipeline/tuning.py:make_dpt_simulator; spec section 5 (no permanent candidate artifacts)
tuning_candidate_libs.rationale: candidate netlists live in a TemporaryDirectory owned by the tuning run and are removed when tuning returns

adaptive_max_step.source: config/inputs/<vendor>.yaml#dpt.max_step; local://unified_rom_spec.md section 3.3 (EPC 100 ns cap on both arms)

eps_rule.rationale: per-table widths: q_oss for the Qoss Vds chain, transfer_vgs for the channel Vgs amp/sat ramps; transfer_vds is the Vds-grid diagnostic (the tanh knee is fitted, not a Vds ramp)

tier2_fallbacks.rationale: inherited from the closed Tier-2 emitter; gate-cap equivalents are evaluated at Cap_ref_Vds so the 4.5 nF / 7.5 pF / 1.5 Ohm fallbacks are not selected

dpt_window_equality.source: docs/deep_spice_fidelity_speed_research.md section 2.1 item 4 (both arms reach the same t_last, relative difference <= 1e-9)

ann_gate_probe.source: models/ann_netlist_builder.py:emit_ann_channel (emitted Vth tanh cutoff and low-VDS guard); local://unified_rom_spec.md section 2.3 (ZERO_CURRENT_FRAC)
ann_gate_probe.rationale: the probe evaluates the emitted G_CH expression; 3 cutoff widths only chooses where to sample, the 1 percent band is unchanged

tier2_regression_gate.rationale: self-consistency diagnostic only: it says whether the emitted model still matches this pipeline's own recorded Tier-2 row; it is never scored in G4_timing_energy or in any verdict

speed_effect_min.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 1.3 / 4.4 (equal-sandbox speed claim); project decision: a real speed effect needs a 1.05 solver ratio
speed_effect_min.rationale: a point ratio above 1.0 without a paired confidence interval is not evidence of a speed improvement; G5 also requires the 95 percent paired-bootstrap CI low above 1.0

speed_speedup_ci.source: common/provenance.py:bootstrap_ci (deterministic percentile bootstrap); SPEED_REPEATS interleaved paired repeats
speed_speedup_ci.rationale: the paired per-repeat solver and wall ratios are resampled 2000 times with seed 0; fewer than two finite samples collapse to the point estimate and a missing repeat list returns None

derivative_sign_gate.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md section 6 G2 (gm/gds physics gate); DERIVATIVE_NEGATIVE_FRACTION_MAX
derivative_sign_gate.rationale: at most 1 percent of finite small-signal derivative samples may be negative; the measured gm/gds minima and sign fractions stay as diagnostics and a missing fraction fails closed

charge_monotonicity.source: local://unified_rom_spec.md sections 1.4 and 6 G6 (charge tables and the 0.5 percent budget)
charge_monotonicity.rationale: every emitted charge table (q_oss, q_iss, q_rss) must be non-decreasing and zero-anchored where applicable; an empty source table is not_applicable, never a pass

record_inputs.source: config/inputs/<vendor>.yaml, the vendor library, config/outputs/<vendor>/curve*.yaml, and the emitted lib
record_inputs.rationale: common/provenance.py:file_hashes hashes the exact inputs used for this record; artifact_manifest re-hashes and verifies the same lib and inputs; a missing file stays null and fails verification

acceptance_policy.rationale: all scored bars come from the validated policy; the file path, schema, source labels and SHA-256 are copied into the record; a malformed file fails closed, an absent file uses the documented legacy-constant fallback

hybrid_basis.source: docs/plans/phase_vi_research_framework.md sections 2.2, 3.2 and 3.3 (C0 base plus ANN residual; independent data-driven ROM; golden timing bars)
hybrid_basis.rationale: hybrid is an explicit non-default basis with keyed artifacts; canonical C0 remains the default and ANN keeps its own record

gate_charge_tables.source: curve4 c_eq_charge*3 / c_eq_energy*0.15 on the curve-4 Vds grid
gate_charge_tables.rationale: closed Tier-2 linear gate-side scalar, tabulated so apply_scalars can add O_GD*V without a hidden fallback
